# Group trip expense settlement

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/trip-settlement/

Calculate who owes whom after shared trip expenses. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Enter what three friends paid and split the total equally to generate a short settlement list.

## Limits and checks

This version splits equally among the listed people. It records balances and does not send payments or access any bank account.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
